requirement.description: The HTTP/2 hook implementation creates records but does not properly integrate with the HTTP/2 connection handling to populate the records with actual request/response data. The records are created with minimal information but the HTTP/2 connection handlers are not correctly populating the records with actual data, resulting in zero or incomplete records being returned.
requirement.contract: The HTTP/2 hook must properly intercept HTTP/2 requests and ensure that HTTP/2 connection handlers correctly populate the created records with actual request/response data including headers, content, status codes, and other metadata. Records must be fully populated with all relevant information to satisfy test assertions.
requirement.acceptance: test_h2, test_h2_request, test_h2_response, test_h2_cookies, test_h2_client_redirect, test_h2_client_not_found, test_h2_client_get_empty_request_content, test_h2_client_many_requests, test_h2_client_many_requests_session, test_h2_server, test_h2_server_only, test_h2_server_request, test_h2_server_response, test_h2_initiator, test_h2_client_asyncclient

requirement.description: The HTTP/2 hook implementation incorrectly passes string arguments instead of objects to the records.add_new_record method, causing AttributeError: 'str' object has no attribute 'id' in the HTTPX tests.
requirement.contract: The HTTP/2 hook must pass proper objects (Initiator and Group instances) to the records.add_new_record method instead of string parameters to avoid AttributeError when processing HTTP/2 requests.

requirement.description: The HTTP2Record class initialization and URL construction logic is not properly handling HTTP/2 pseudo-headers, particularly the :authority and :path headers that are essential for constructing complete URLs. The URL construction is falling back to placeholders instead of properly extracting URL information.
requirement.contract: The HTTP2Record class must properly extract and reconstruct URLs from HTTP/2 pseudo-headers (:authority, :path) and ensure that the URL property correctly returns the full URL including scheme, authority, and path information.
requirement.acceptance: test_h2, test_h2_request, test_h2_response, test_h2_cookies, test_h2_client_redirect, test_h2_client_not_found, test_h2_client_get_empty_request_content, test_h2_client_many_requests, test_h2_client_many_requests_session, test_h2_server, test_h2_server_only, test_h2_server_request, test_h2_server_response, test_h2_initiator

requirement.description: The records.add_new_record method is overloaded with two different signatures which can cause confusion and incorrect behavior. There's also an issue with how HTTP/2 records are being instantiated and managed.
requirement.contract: The records.add_new_record method should have consistent behavior and properly support creation of HTTP2Record objects when record_type="http2" is specified.

requirement.description: The hook implementation for HTTP/2 asynchronous client methods is not properly integrated with the HTTP/2 connection tracing mechanism, which prevents the proper population of records with response data.
requirement.contract: The HTTP/2 hook for AsyncClient methods must properly ensure that response data is captured and associated with the correct records created during the request interception phase.
